title: CSX announces partnership with Niron Magnetics on manufacturing campus after stock ends session up 1.4% - Traders Union
Union Pacific Has Raised Its Dividend for 20 Years. These 3 Railroads Offer Income
summary: Three railroads sit on networks no rival could ever rebuild, yet their yields look thin and one dividend has not budged in years. A pending merger and a regulator's pending ruling could decide which payout deserves a spot in your income plan.
